title: The top Canadian cities in 2026
gist: Oxford Economics' 2026 Global Cities Index ranks Toronto (20th globally), Vancouver (24th) and Montreal (62nd) as Canada's top cities, outscoring US peers on Human Capital, Governance and Quality of Life but forecast to grow slower than US cities over five years. Oil-rich Edmonton ('City to Watch') and Calgary are the growth exceptions, shielded from the US trade war by Trans Mountain-enabled non-US oil exports, while Toronto, Montreal and Hamilton manufacturing suffers and housing unaffordability drags Toronto and Vancouver.

insights.so_what: Canadian capex and export-city growth remain hostage to USMCA outcome; a deal would be a re-rating catalyst.
